confidence_notes: Restaurant meals and cappuccino use Puducherry cost-of-living prices; pub beer figures vary across indexes. Cocktail and wine estimates use current local bar-menu prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate and is especially uncertain because of seasonal and heritage-district variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Pondicherry/Puducherry cost-of-living entries and local bar menus. Accommodation is estimated for modest South Indian coastal-city guesthouses, with an allowance for Puducherry's heritage-tourism demand.
